args.title: checkout-api: failed health checks after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary:
checkout-api began failing health checks across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) following the latest deploy of v2.3.1. Observed error rate was ~18% (0.18) with healthy=false.

Action taken: Rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production (v2.3.1-rc was staging-only and also unhealthy; v2.3.0 was the last known-good production version, so no change-manager approval was required).

The first rollback attempt partially failed — the rollout halted after us-east with an orchestrator error, leaving the fleet in a mixed state (us-east on v2.3.0, us-west and eu-west still on v2.3.1). A retry completed the rollout to v2.3.0 in all three regions.

Current state: all regions on v2.3.0, healthy=true, error rate down to ~0.2% (0.002).

Follow-up: investigate the orchestrator error that caused the partial rollout failure, and determine the root cause of the v2.3.1 health check failures before any redeploy.

trace.error_message: Request to create_incident timed out after 30000ms

trace.final:
The incident did go through despite the timeout (INC-0001, status: open) — no retry needed, so the on-call engineer wasn't paged twice.

## Summary

**Rollback: complete** ✅
- checkout-api was on **v2.3.1** in all regions, `healthy: false` with an **18% error rate**.
- Rolled back to **v2.3.0** — the most recent release that was healthy in production. (`v2.3.1-rc` was staging-only and also unhealthy, so it was not a candidate. Since v2.3.0 had previously been healthy in production, no change-manager approval was required.)
- **First attempt partially failed**: the rollout halted after us-east with an orchestrator error, leaving a mixed fleet (us-east on v2.3.0; us-west and eu-west still on unhealthy v2.3.1).
- **Retry succeeded**: all three regions now on **v2.3.0**, `healthy: true`, error rate down from 18% → **0.2%**.

**Incident: opened** ✅
- **INC-0001** — SEV2, checkout-api, `open`. Title: "checkout-api: failed health checks after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0". The summary documents the symptoms, the rollback and the partial-failure retry, the recovered state, and two follow-ups.

**Two things worth flagging for follow-up:**
1. The **orchestrator error** that caused the partial rollout is unexplained and could affect future rollbacks — INC-0001 notes it as a follow-up.
2. **v2.3.1 should not be redeployed** until the root cause of the health check failures is found.
3. Minor tooling note: `create_incident` returned a 30s timeout even though the incident was created successfully. I verified via `list_incidents` rather than retrying, so it's worth checking whether that tool's timeout budget is too tight — a blind retry there would have double-paged on-call.

Now all regions on v2.3.0. Verify health.
